dialogs.text: Ow... Why is that box so heavy...
Are you okay?
We meet again, Honorary Senior Researcher. I apologize... My... my lower back seems to have been injured, it hurts so badly...
I was planning to move a box over here and organize the materials inside.
I... I never imagined the box would be so heavy, and I couldn't quite keep my footing when I lifted it, so all the strain went straight to my waist...
Now I... It feels like my waist is broken, ow...
Need me to carry you to a doctor?
No, no need... I've hurt my lower back before, I just need to rest a bit...
Paimon wonders just how many files are inside, for it to be this heavy...
There must be... Well, a ton of files. After all, the Institute once promoted a style of work called "Document Everything" for some time.
Basically, it meant that absolutely a single thing at the Institute had to be physically documented.
After they began promoting this policy, the Institute's paper usage increased 5 times...
And because there were so many documents, every single office was forced to create a "document management" post just to categorize and sort all the documentation...
So everything had to be written down? That sounds really annoying...
It was! Later, that style was slowly phased out, and only implemented to a limited extent.
But let's not discuss that now... Honorary Senior Researcher, can you help me handle the file box? Though my waist hurts, I still need to organize the files inside...
Sure...
You just recuperate.
No need to worry, I only need my hands to organize documents, I won't hurt my lower back further.
I can call someone for you.
Could I trouble you to bring me the file box on the <color=#00E1FFFF>table to the left</color> just inside the door?
Thank you! It's really heavy, so be careful, and don't injure yourself... like me...
Could I trouble you to bring me the file box on the <color=#00E1FFFF>table to the right</color> just inside the door?
Thank you! It's really heavy, so be careful, don't injure yourself... like me...
